description: This file defines the StockStatus class within the Opencart system, responsible for retrieving stock status information from the database, including individual statuses and lists of statuses, with cache support.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: A class providing methods to retrieve stock status data from the database, including individual status and multiple statuses with optional filters and caching.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status record by its ID, considering the current language configuration.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of stock status records with optional ordering and pagination, utilizing caching for efficiency.
